summary: Verified HUD & in-match readability at 8.1/10, ON PAR (>= 7.5, no confirmed blocker). The reviewer's single major (item icon art unchanged; fill 0.47 at slot size) reproduces: closing2 icon_probe summary is byte-identical to the first-closing closing_hud_verify_icon_probe.json and the last commit to content/ui/icons/items (69c4cd074, 2026-10-29 03:26) predates the first closing review (8a372f208, 2026-10-29 12:04). It stays major as backlog because the owner asked for better item images. All five minors reproduce in code or shots; two gauge statements are softened (LoL damage numbers do pass over bars at times; LoL champion portraits also overlap on the minimap). Recap-chip and overkill findings were shown with an injected 10,000,000 hit, but the CSS has no nowrap, so three realistic chips (about 117 px each) still overflow the roughly 300 px card. overlay_regress PASS and hud_renders were run on 2026-11-07 after the last src commit (3c6aebffd 13:45). Load was 7.8 or more, so no timing was measured. Score lowered 0.1 from 8.2 because the owner's two explicit asks (item images, a much better minimap) are both still art-unchanged, apart from the numerals.

findings.title: Item icon art is unchanged since the first closing: subjects fill under half the slot and the red Strike family blurs together
findings.what: The 57 item paintings are the same files that were graded at the first closing. At the 38 px inventory slot, slot 1 reads as a white blob with purple strokes and slot 2 as a busy tangle. Strike items share a red ground with similar blades and picks.
findings.evidence: _harness/_reports/closing2_hud_icon_probe.json summary is identical to _harness/_reports/closing_hud_verify_icon_probe.json (items 38: n 57, p50 median 74 / min 66, p95 min 192, fill median 0.47; strike 19). `git log -- content/ui/icons/items`: the last change is 69c4cd074 at 2026-10-29 03:26, before the first closing review 8a372f208 at 12:04. Shots: _harness/_shots/closing2_hud_Z_items_4x.png, closing2_hud_B10_shop.png (suggested row: 360/1,250/2,150 on red ground, plus the BASIC row).
findings.gauge: LoL item icons read at slot size from one dominant silhouette that fills most of the square. Items in one stat family are told apart by shape.
findings.fix: Repaint in VALE's chalk-and-lamplight style the Strike items and every item with fill under 0.55. Give each one bold object at 65 % fill or more, a warm rim and a distinct shape. Add a per-item accent within the family ground. Add a fill floor and an intra-family distance check to icon_probe.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced from both probe reports and git history. The icons are not unreadable (the shop is usable and each item has its own painting; the 95 icon refs are 57 items plus their passives sharing art). Major, not blocker, because of the owner's explicit ask. Backlog under ruling 8.

findings.title: Minimap chart art is still a flat survey diagram; the numerals are the only change
findings.what: Lanes are uniform grey bands and camps are dark discs. Stacked portraits merge (bottom lane: 3-4 rings).
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing2_hud_Z_minimap_3x.png. src/ui/hud/minimap.tsx was last changed in eca85d339 (2026-10-29). Numerals came in 67f000211 (2026-11-03).
findings.gauge: LoL's minimap is a painted miniature of the terrain. Its champion icons also overlap when grouped, so the stacking part of the gauge is overstated; the terrain-painting part holds.
findings.fix: Bake the RIFT chart top-down from the real terrain with a posterized texture and chalk wall edges. Optionally fan out portraits that overlap by more than 60 %.
findings.verifierNote: Kept minor: it is functional and clearly legible (fog, timers, numerals). The owner's 'much better minimap' ask is only half met on art.

findings.title: Death recap damage-type chips overflow their fixed 20 px pills
findings.what: When three types are present the chip content wraps onto two lines inside a 20 px pill.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing2_hud_c_A11_death_recap.png, closing2_hud_Z_recap_chips_3x.png. src/ui/styles/hud.css:515 `.recap__types { display: flex; gap: 4px; }` and :518 `.dchip {... height: 20px ...}`, with no nowrap and no wrap. The shot used an injected 10,000,000 hit, but three realistic chips ('Physical 1,284' is about 117 px each) also exceed the roughly 300 px card, so the bug is real in play.
findings.gauge: LoL's death recap damage split is clean single-line figures.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed from the CSS. The extreme shot exaggerates it, but realistic widths still overflow.

findings.title: A four-kill wipe shows the team-wipe banner before the player's multikill; the queue runs about 10.5 s
findings.what: The team wipe and the four-takedown banner share rank 4, so the first one queued wins.
findings.gauge: LoL announces the player's multikill, then the ace.
findings.fix: Break the rank tie in favour of the player's own multikill. Fold the same-tick streak line into its sub.

findings.title: Floating damage numbers draw over the enemy fighter's HP bar
findings.what: '112' sits directly on ostler_k's HP fill.
findings.gauge: LoL damage numbers pop near the head and drift, and they can briefly cross the bar too. The claim that they always stay clear of the bar strip is overstated. They do not sit centred on the bar fill.
findings.fix: Spawn the numbers at chest height with a lateral drift, or layer the bars above the numbers.
findings.verifierNote: Reproduced in the shot. Gauge softened. Severity stays minor.

findings.title: Overkill inflates the Damage stat, damage taken and the death recap
findings.what: The bookkeeping adds the raw `amount` after HP is clamped at 0.
findings.evidence: src/sim/combat.ts:109-110 clamp hp; :116 damageToFighters += amount; :119 damageTaken += amount; :122 dmgLog pushes amount. The reviewer's huge scoreboard numbers came from injected hits. In play the excess is bounded by one finishing hit.
findings.gauge: Players compare post-game damage figures. Overkill on the final blow should not distort them noticeably.
findings.fix: Credit min(amount - shielded, hpBefore) + shielded for the stats and the recap; keep amount for the floating number.
findings.verifierNote: Code confirmed. The impact in real matches is small.
